title: Editorial cut
premise: The same session read as a fashion film. A high-contrast serif carries the line and a bold grotesque interrupts it, over long holds and one hard burst.
notes: Measured off Gym-Inspiration/Gym_2.MP4: 25 cuts in 27.4s, median shot 1.00s, a four-cut burst at 16.3-17.9s, and type running to 351px on a 663px strip — over half the picture height on its largest word.
Two type voices alternating is the whole identity. One face alone reads as either a perfume ad or a sports brand, and this is neither.
This pack allows words to run past the frame edge, which the reference does deliberately on a word set larger than the strip.

shots.what: You walking into the empty gym, from behind, low angle, hard rim light down one side
shots.subject: required
shots.shoot: Low, below waist height, looking up. Backlight only — a rim on the shoulders is what survives the grade. Walk away from the lens, not towards it.

shots.what: Mid-shot, you setting up, still. The frame is mostly dark and mostly empty.
shots.subject: required
shots.shoot: Hold four seconds without moving. Empty space on one side of frame is not wasted — it is where the words go.

shots.what: Hands on the bar, chalk, the knurl
shots.subject: optional
shots.shoot: Close enough that the hand fills a third of frame. This is one of the shots that will carry a matte, so keep the background darker than the hand.

shots.what: You from directly behind, arms out, filling the centre of frame
shots.subject: required
shots.shoot: The single most useful shot in this blueprint. A large, clean, centred silhouette is what makes text-behind-subject read at all.

shots.what: The working set — any angle, as long as something moves in every frame
shots.subject: required
shots.shoot: This slot is cut into six fragments of a fifth of a second each. Every one needs visible motion; a still frame inside a burst reads as a dropped frame. Shoot one long continuous take, not six.

shots.what: The rep at its hardest — the face, the veins, the bar bending
shots.subject: required
shots.shoot: Get in close and stay there. Two takes minimum.

shots.what: Low detail — shoes, the plate on the floor, dust
shots.subject: optional
shots.shoot: Camera on the floor. A pattern interrupt that costs nothing to shoot.

shots.what: The finish — you standing up out of it, arms wide, everything released
shots.subject: required
shots.shoot: Shoot at 4K60 so this can be ramped down into a hold. The references decelerate into their payoff rather than speeding into it, and that is what makes it land.

shots.what: You holding still afterwards, breathing, half-lit
shots.subject: required
shots.shoot: Let it run long. This is where the last words of the lyric sit.

shots.what: Back to the opening framing — you walking out, or the empty room
shots.subject: optional
shots.shoot: Match the hook's framing so the loop closes invisibly. Same lens, same height, same wall.
